semantic_model.name: nls_building_overviews
semantic_model.description: Building footprints from the National Land Survey of Finland topographic database (Maastotietokanta, rakennus feature class), published as a cloud-native GeoParquet with precomputed geometry overviews for multi-scale rendering. Coordinates are in ETRS89 / TM35FIN (EPSG:3067). Each building appears once per overview band, band 0 carries the original geometry and bands 1 and 2 carry simplified overview geometries.

ai_context.instructions: Filter on band = 0 for analysis so that each building is counted once. Use the overview bands only for rendering at small scales. Attribute codes follow the NLS Maastotietokanta feature catalogue.

datasets.name: buildings
datasets.description: One row per building per overview band, 5.65 million rows covering all of Finland.

fields.name: ogc_fid
fields.description: Sequential feature identifier assigned during conversion.

fields.name: mtk_id
fields.description: Persistent feature identifier in the NLS topographic database.

fields.name: location_accuracy_mm
fields.description: Planar location accuracy of the feature in millimeters (sijaintitarkkuus).

fields.name: data_source
fields.description: NLS source code for the capture method (aineistolahde).

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: Date the feature version became valid (alkupvm).

fields.name: feature_group
fields.description: NLS feature group code, 75 for buildings (kohderyhma).

fields.name: feature_class
fields.description: NLS feature class code from the Maastotietokanta catalogue (kohdeluokka).

fields.name: elevation_accuracy
fields.description: Elevation accuracy code (korkeustarkkuus).

fields.name: usage_purpose
fields.description: Building usage purpose code (kayttotarkoitus).

fields.name: floor_count
fields.description: Floor count code (kerrosluku).

fields.name: base_elevation
fields.description: Elevation of the building base (pohjankorkeus).

fields.name: height_value
fields.description: Building height value when recorded (korkeusarvo).

fields.name: reference_point
fields.description: Building reference point as a GeoJSON string in EPSG:3067 (sijainti_piste).

fields.name: xmin
fields.description: Minimum easting of the feature bounding box in EPSG:3067.

fields.name: ymin
fields.description: Minimum northing of the feature bounding box in EPSG:3067.

fields.name: xmax
fields.description: Maximum easting of the feature bounding box in EPSG:3067.

fields.name: ymax
fields.description: Maximum northing of the feature bounding box in EPSG:3067.

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: Building footprint polygon in EPSG:3067, WKB encoded.

fields.name: bbox
fields.description: Per-feature bounding box struct from the GeoParquet covering convention.

fields.name: band
fields.description: Overview level, 0 is the original geometry and 1 and 2 are simplified overviews.

fields.name: geom_overview
fields.description: Simplified overview polygon for the band in EPSG:3067, WKB encoded.

metrics.name: building_count
metrics.description: Number of distinct buildings, counted once regardless of overview band.

metrics.name: avg_floor_count
metrics.description: Average floor count code across buildings at band 0.

metrics.name: total_footprint_area_m2
metrics.description: Total building footprint area in square meters, computed on the original band 0 geometries in EPSG:3067.
